firstScreen.notes: dist/index.html: h1 'House Cleaning in Chattanooga, TN' (6 words, trade+city). Primary 'Price it' + ghost phone. Proof line with sample-tagged rating. Kicker establishes almanac. No screenshots to verify next-band peek or intro timing; conservative -0.5 each for unverified peek and motion readability.

distinctiveness.notes: dist/index.html: season dial in header (line 500), four almanac sections, footer (line 895) = 4+ sections. Editorial almanac concept unique. Fraunces/Source Sans 3/DM Mono trio distinctive. -0.5 for dial possibly reading as decoration; -0.5 for four identical split shapes in almanac spreads.

type.notes: dist/index.html: Fraunces variable display, Source Sans 3 body, DM Mono accent. Fluid clamp scale. Tabular numerals on prices. Lead paragraph set apart. H1 dramatic clamp 2.6rem-5rem. Letter-spacing -0.03em on headings. Smart quotes in reviews appear correct.

layout.notes: dist/index.html: 11 sections with alternating tones (t-deep/t-accent/t-paper/t-mid/t-light). Split layouts alternate direction. Full-bleed break. Rail layout for area/footer. -0.5 for four almanac spreads using identical split shape (same shape 3+ times).

photo.notes: dist/index.html: On-topic images (pollen, grout, Chattanooga house, holiday table, living room). Consistent filter (saturate .8, contrast 1.05, sepia .12, brightness .95). Alt text descriptive except hero. Width/height/lazy/srcset present. Hero preloaded. Stock ceiling applies.

copy.notes: dist/index.html: Voice matches concept samples (Signal Mountain, heart pine, grout, caulk). No banned words. Buttons named for action. Sample labels on all prices/reviews. Microcopy under form. Consistent 'Price it' primary action. Datelines ground locally.

mobile.notes: dist/index.html: Mobile bar with call+book (min-height 48px). Header collapses below 900px. Form inputs full-width. ZIP checker stacks. No horizontal scroll expected. Season dial hidden below 900px. Cannot verify composed-for-phone decisions without screenshots.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: Skip link. Focus 3px solid var(--focus) offset 3px. Labels on all inputs. aria-live on ZIP/countdown results. aria-expanded on menu. Reduced motion media query. Forced colors borders. Print stylesheet. Heading order h1->h2 no skips. Season dial aria-hidden.

motion.notes: dist/index.html: data-reveal translateY on sections. data-reveal=clip on figures. data-split=lines on h1. data-reveal-stagger on cards/reviews. Lenis/GSAP loaded. Reduced motion respected. -0.5 for uniform reveal type across most sections; only clip and split provide variation.

wow.notes: dist/index.html: Season dial signature ties to almanac thesis. Countdown tool for holiday planning. Editorial format memorable. -0.5 for countdown output appearing text-only (.countdown-tool__result); -0.5 for dial being subtle (48px, aria-hidden) and not integrated with tool output.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon. OG 1200x630. JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness. Theme-color. Print stylesheet. Lazy images with dimensions. Hero preload. Consistent 3px radius. Footer designed. -0.5 for generic 'Photo by unknown on Pexels' credits x6.

mustFix.problem: Alt text is 'Placeholder hero C1', not descriptive of actual image content
mustFix.fix: Replace with descriptive alt matching the image, e.g., 'Morning fog over the Tennessee River with riverside houses in Chattanooga'

elevate.move: Drive the season dial rotation with ScrollTrigger tied to almanac section entry so the dial actively turns as each season enters view; vary reveal types with clip-path wipes for almanac text and scale reveals for service cards instead of uniform translateY

Break the four identical split layouts by making one almanac spread a full-width editorial statement with embedded tool, and thread the season dial into the countdown tool output so the active segment highlights when a date is selected
